title: 3.8.11 Lab: Round-Trip an Array of Objects
description: Round-trip a game-state shape — an object holding an array of item objects — through stringify and parse, then read a nested field back. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Build the game-state object
steps.instructions: Create a variable holding an object with a player name and an array of at least two item objects. Each item should have a name and a price.

steps.title: Save the whole thing
steps.instructions: Use JSON.stringify to turn the game state into text.

steps.title: Restore it and reach a nested field
steps.instructions: Use JSON.parse to rebuild it, then use console.log to print the price of the second item plus ten, and the item's name. The nesting is array inside object.

requirements.title: Game-state object declared
requirements.description: Declares an object with curly braces

requirements.title: An array of objects inside
requirements.description: Contains an array whose elements are objects

requirements.title: Restored with parse
requirements.description: Calls JSON.parse on the saved text
